summary: Draft of the spring opening announcement for members. I added the plot fees and moved the sign-up deadline to 20 March. Approve it, or tell me what to change before it goes out on Friday.
doc:
# Spring opening at Larkspur Community Garden

The gates open again on **Saturday, 4 April**. After a quiet winter the beds are dug, the new tool shed is finished, and the first seedlings are already waiting in the greenhouse.

## What is new this season

- A second water tap at the north end, so nobody has to carry cans across the whole site
- Raised beds for members who would rather not kneel
- A shared seed shelf in the shed: bring what you have left over, take what you need

## Opening day

We start at 10:00 with coffee by the shed and a short walk around the plots. At 11:00 there is a hands-on session on *planting early potatoes*. Children are welcome; there will be a corner with flower pots to paint.

## Plot fees

| Plot | Size | Season fee |
|---|---:|---:|
| Small | 10 m² | €35 |
| Standard | 20 m² | €60 |
| Raised bed | 2 m² | €20 |

Fees cover water, tools and the spring compost delivery. If the fee is a problem, talk to us: nobody loses a plot over money.

## How to sign up

Fill in the [sign-up form](https://larkspur.example/signup) or reply to this message by **20 March**. Current members get their plot back automatically and only need to confirm.

See you among the beds,
The garden team
